implementation: Private AppendLease owns one original root/generation, bounded committed prefix and a unique suffix authority. Ordinary ReadLease/WriteLease contract/layout is unchanged. No duplicate page pool, interval permission map, alternate executor or provider/model whitelist.

Fresh typed page publish_appendable returns an immutable bounded ReadLease and move-only PagedPageAppender. Only monotone consecutive suffix may be reserved. Legacy whole-page ready guards cannot promote to append authority; old readers never widen. Full-page commit consumes the tail.

Original Graph permissions validate every old bounded read against the actual original tail; one root receives exactly one qualified append admission covering its suffix and old prefix read. Whole writers cannot mix with append. Existing actual Queue/Completion/reaper lifetime remains authoritative, failed suffix affects only its append epoch.

PagedAppendPages validates exact old/new layouts and reserved row ranges before moving callers. Fresh targets use original COW; tails write only reserved suffix. The native wire and CUDA leaf are unchanged; no NVCC needed. Whole-Graph success plus true retirement precedes publication; retired failure rolls back without changing old reader bounds.

Qwen Session alone owns12 tail authorities matching its exact committed head. Prefix Hits/Snapshots do not copy authority; branches without a tail use original COW. All state/KV results are assembled before atomically replacing the visible head. No change to state pool backing reservations or speculative prefix checkpoint generation.

Consumer PrefixCache is now one bounded compressed radix forest with exact token edges/model+math domains, payload LRU and counted readonly pins. Structure-only splits have no state. Cold arrays include bounded atomic commit scratch; lookup worst O(L+E) versus previous repeated O(E*L) token comparisons, not strict O(L). Valid mutations allocate no ordinary heap after construction.
